title: runbun.json
description: How runbun.dev opens and runs this project. Every field is optional; the file may hold comments and trailing commas. In an embed, what the host page sets wins.

run.description: What Run starts, instead of the guess (package.json's module, main, dev script, else index.ts).

autorun.description: Run once opened (default true). Code from a shared link or a GitHub repo always waits for the reader's Run.

env.description: process.env for the program (in the browser). Not for secrets: this file is shared with the project.

open.description: Files opened as tabs, in order; the first is shown. Default: the entry file.

hidden.description: Files kept out of the tabs; they stay in the project and the file tree.

panels.description: Panes to show (true) or hide (false) when the project opens; the others stay as they are. The reader can still toggle them.

tabs.description: The editor's tab bar (embeds; the playground always has it).

preview.description: The preview of a running server.

sizes.description: Each pane's share of space when the project opens, in percent. The reader can still drag the borders; in the playground what they drag stays theirs.

files.description: The file tree's share of the width, e.g. 20.

editor.description: The editor's share of the room the tree leaves, beside the preview and console (of the height when they sit under it, as in a stacked embed), e.g. 60.

preview.description: The preview's share of the column it shares with the console; the console gets the rest, e.g. 70.

path.description: What the preview requests first, e.g. "/user/123".

requests.description: Requests a reader can try, each in its own preview tab: "METHOD /path [-H \"Name: value\"] [body]", e.g. "POST /echo {\"hello\": \"Bun\"}". Wins over path.

requires.description: What it can't run without: cross-origin isolation (Vite, Rolldown), or Bun on the reader's machine (child processes, native addons). The playground says so up front.
